mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 56 degrees.

October is officially Community Planning Month in Verona as proclaimed by Mayor Diaz to thank the Planning and Development Department for their service. Also, don't forget about the free tri-shaw Bike program available at the Senior Center which offers rides along the Military Ridge State Trail.

It is a packed day in Verona! Today, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, the World Dairy Expo at the Alliant Energy Center, and the Farley Center Fall Festival. Tomorrow, you can check out yoga at Insight Wellness.
On September 24, officers responded to a collision between a vehicle and an 11-year-old bicyclist at Westward Drive and Jenna Drive; thankfully, the child did not require hospitalization.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Andes Mint Avalanche. Our local Culver's is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM.
